column1: # stale-api.tsv -- single-regex, line-level rules for deprecated or dangerous Kernel identifiers (PLAN 4.8).
# Tab separated; '#' lines ignored. Fed to the H3 tripwire, `kernel-plugin lint` and tests/run.sh.
# columns: id | severity (low|med|high) | ERE | message (ASCII, no trailing period) | replacement | since/removed | URL
# ERE: POSIX, matched per line by awk and grep -E: no \s \w \d, no {n,m} intervals (older mawk), so K019 spells them out.
# Every rule needs a URL plus fixtures tests/fixtures/rules/<id>.pos.ts and <id>.neg.ts (tests/run.sh enforces it).
# URLs were checked to answer HTTP 200; anchors into the changelog are deliberately omitted (not verified).
